P-e340a.registered: GROUNDS: (1) THE ANNEALING-FUNCTION ARGUMENT — the controller's 32 error-gated name-only maintenance events ARE functionally an annealing of the read against corpus-class shocks (each event restored the read after a budgeted corpus step; 32 restore cycles selected a read landscape that RE-FORMS after perturbation — the capacity e338's install-fresh read lacked: dip at s1 to 0.004, never recovered). (2) THE GEOMETRY ARGUMENT — the events fired on the TRUE TAVIREN install windows (decode-gated, pre-context bit-equal the anchor bank): the annealing was purchased ON the read channel the battery reads. (3) THE HEIGHT-MARGIN ARGUMENT — the dispatch's own: height is the live variable and this subject sits at 0.873, cons-class. COUNTERVAILING (equal force): (a) BINARY-OUTCOME — under the SAME projected s1 shock the e338-vs-ball outcome gap (0.004 vs ~1.0) is too binary for the ~1.2-nat margin gap (4.8 vs 6.0); if the discriminator is categorical, the cons's 300 JITTER steps vary contexts/positions while the controller's events never did (fixed pre-contexts) — the routes differ on exactly the axis the cons is named for; (b) DIFFERENT-LANDSCAPE — the t800 state sits 1.87 L2 from the install along the controller's budgeted path; the dip-and-RECOVER signature has never been observed on a controller-annealed state, and this read's history is a slowly RECEDING equilibrium (3.148x peak at t600 -> 3.055x at t800) held by a still-firing 2-cycle dose loop.
P-e340a.predicted_shape: the twin dies at s1 (sand class); the committed arm takes a W1-class DIP at s1-s5 to ~0.35-0.65 ABSOLUTE (a dip, not an annihilation) and recovers/settles; retention@s100 in [0.55, 1.09]; in-band or >= 0.5 -> READ-HOLDS; alive in (0.10, 0.5) -> MIXED (the partial-margin discriminator).
P-e340a.falsifier: the committed read < 0.05 at s1 (the annihilation signature repeating at cons-class HEIGHT — height was not the margin; the cons shaping stands -> READ-DIES); or the twin ALIVE (a both-live MIXED — the wash-fragility premise itself re-opens).
